name: skill-forge
description: Meta-skill and design compass for creating new skills and upgrading existing ones with a deliberate push toward being maximally technological, creative, and aesthetically disciplined. Use when the user wants to create a skill from scratch, reshape an existing skill, make a skill more reliable/technological, more creative/varied, or more visually polished — or when a skill feels templated, generic, or mechanically weak.
author: bestdeejay-design
